controls.title: Risk analysis
controls.description: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of potential risks and vulnerabilities to ePHI.
controls.evidence_guidance: Documented risk analysis plus continuous vulnerability identification.

checks.rationale: The documented risk analysis is the core artifact.
Recurring scans evidence ongoing vulnerability assessment.

controls.title: Risk management
controls.description: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level.
controls.evidence_guidance: Findings remediated within SLA; no open criticals.

checks.rationale: Zero open criticals evidences risks reduced to an appropriate level.
SLA-timely remediation evidences active risk management.

controls.title: Workforce security
controls.description: Ensure workforce members have appropriate access to ePHI and prevent unauthorized access.

checks.rationale: The access policy defines appropriate access.

controls.title: Security awareness and training
controls.description: Implement a security awareness and training program for all workforce members.

checks.rationale: Training completion records evidence the program.

controls.title: Security incident procedures
controls.description: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents, including response and reporting.

checks.rationale: The IR policy is the required procedure.

controls.title: Audit controls
controls.description: Implement mechanisms that record and examine activity in systems containing or using ePHI.

checks.rationale: The operative audit trail is the audit-controls mechanism.

controls.title: Contingency plan
controls.description: Establish policies for responding to emergencies that damage systems containing ePHI, including testing.

checks.rationale: Tested contingency exercises evidence the plan.
